verses.en: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:
verses.pt: Houve um homem de Ramataim-Zofim, da região montanhosa de Efraim, cujo nome era Elcana, filho de Jeroão, filho de Eliú, filho de Toú, filho de Zufe, efraimita.
verses.en_web: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
verses.en_bbe: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim, a Zuphite of the hill-country of Ephraim, named Elkanah; he was the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite:

verses.en: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.pt: Tinha ele duas mulheres: uma se chamava Ana, e a outra Penina. Penina tinha filhos, porém Ana não os tinha.
verses.en_web: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.en_bbe: And he had two wives, one named Hannah and the other Peninnah: and Peninnah was the mother of children, but Hannah had no children.

verses.en: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD, were there.
verses.pt: De ano em ano este homem subia da sua cidade para adorar e sacrificar ae Senhor dos exércites em Siló. Assistiam ali os sacerdotes do Senhor, Hofni e Finéias, os dois filhos de Eli.
verses.en_web: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to Yahweh of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to Yahweh, were there.
verses.en_bbe: Now this man went up from his town every year to give worship and to make offerings to the Lord of armies in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the Lord, were there.

verses.en: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:
verses.pt: No dia em que Elcana sacrificava, costumava dar quinhões a Penina, sua mulher, e a todos os seus filhos e filhas;
verses.en_web: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions;
verses.en_bbe: And when the day came for Elkanah to make his offering, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and daughters, their part of the feast:

verses.en: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the LORD had shut up her womb.
verses.pt: porém a Ana, embora a amasse, dava um só quinhão, porquanto o Senhor lhe havia cerrado a madre.
verses.en_web: but to Hannah he gave a double portion, for he loved Hannah, but Yahweh had shut up her womb.
verses.en_bbe: But to Hannah he gave one part, though Hannah was very dear to him, but the Lord had not let her have children.

verses.en: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because the LORD had shut up her womb.
verses.pt: Ora, a sua rival muito a provocava para irritá-la, porque o Senhor lhe havia cerrado a madre.
verses.en_web: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.
verses.en_bbe: And the other wife did everything possible to make her unhappy, because the Lord had not let her have children;

verses.en: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
verses.pt: E assim sucedia de ano em ano que, ao subirem à casa do Senhor, Penina provocava a Ana; pelo que esta chorava e não comia.
verses.en_web: As he did so year by year, when she went up to Yahweh’s house. Her rival provoked her; therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.
verses.en_bbe: And year by year, whenever she went up to the house of the Lord, she kept on attacking her, so that Hannah gave herself up to weeping and would take no food.

verses.en: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?
verses.pt: Então Elcana, seu marido, lhe perguntou: Ana, por que choras? e porque não comes? e por que está triste o teu coração? Não te sou eu melhor de que dez filhos?
verses.en_web: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”
verses.en_bbe: Then her husband Elkanah said to her, Hannah, why are you weeping? and why are you taking no food? why is your heart troubled? am I not more to you than ten sons?

verses.en: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD.
verses.pt: Então Ana se levantou, depois que comeram e beberam em Siló; e Eli, sacerdote, estava sentado, numa cadeira, junto a um pilar do templo do Senhor.
verses.en_web: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of Yahweh’s temple.
verses.en_bbe: So after they had taken food and wine in the guest room, Hannah got up. Now Eli the priest was seated by the pillars of the doorway of the Temple of the Lord.

verses.en: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD, and wept sore.
verses.pt: Ela, pois, com amargura de alma, orou ao Senhor, e chorou muito,
verses.en_web: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to Yahweh, weeping bitterly.
verses.en_bbe: And with grief in her soul, weeping bitterly, she made her prayer to the Lord.

verses.en: And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.
verses.pt: e fez um voto, dizendo: ç Senhor dos exércitos! se deveras atentares para a aflição da tua serva, e de mim te lembrares, e da tua serva não te esqueceres, mas lhe deres um filho varão, ao Senhor o darei por todos os dias da sua vida, e pela sua cabeça não passará navalha.
verses.en_web: She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant, and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”
verses.en_bbe: And she made an oath, and said, O Lord of armies, if you will truly take note of the sorrow of your servant, not turning away from me but keeping me in mind, and will give me a man-child, then I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life, and his hair will never be cut.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the LORD, that Eli marked her mouth.
verses.pt: Continuando ela a orar perante e Senhor, Eli observou a sua boca;
verses.en_web: As she continued praying before Yahweh, Eli saw her mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Now while she was a long time in prayer before the Lord, Eli was watching her mouth.

verses.en: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
verses.pt: porquanto Ana falava no seu coração; só se moviam os seus lábios, e não se ouvia a sua voz; pelo que Eli a teve por embriagada,
verses.en_web: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.
verses.en_bbe: For Hannah's prayer came from her heart, and though her lips were moving she made no sound: so it seemed to Eli that she was overcome with wine.

verses.en: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.
verses.pt: e lhe disse: Até quando estarás tu embriagada? Aparta de ti o teu vinho.
verses.en_web: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”
verses.en_bbe: And Eli said to her, How long are you going to be the worse for drink? Put away the effects of your wine from you.

verses.en: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunken neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.
verses.pt: Mas Ana respondeu: Não, Senhor meu, eu sou uma mulher atribulada de espírito; não bebi vinho nem bebida forte, porém derramei a minha alma perante o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And Hannah, answering him, said, No, my lord, I am a woman whose spirit is broken with sorrow: I have not taken wine or strong drink, but I have been opening my heart before the Lord.

verses.en: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.
verses.pt: Não tenhas, pois, a tua serva por filha de Belial; porque da multidão dos meus cuidados e do meu desgosto tenho falado até agora.
verses.en_web: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”
verses.en_bbe: Do not take your servant to be a good-for-nothing woman: for my words have come from my stored-up sorrow and pain.

verses.en: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.
verses.pt: Então lhe respondeu Eli: Vai-te em paz; e o Deus de Israel te conceda a petição que lhe fizeste.
verses.en_web: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Eli said to her, Go in peace: and may the God of Israel give you an answer to the prayer you have made to him.

verses.en: And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.
verses.pt: Ao que disse ela: Ache a tua serva graça aos teus olhos. Assim a mulher se foi o seu caminho, e comeu, e já não era triste o seu semblante.
verses.en_web: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way, and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.
verses.en_bbe: And she said, May your servant have grace in your eyes. So the woman went away, and took part in the feast, and her face was no longer sad.

verses.en: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the LORD, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.
verses.pt: Depois, levantando-se de madrugada, adoraram perante o Senhor e, voltando, foram a sua casa em Ramá. Elcana conheceu a Ana, sua mulher, e o Senhor se lembrou dela.
verses.en_web: They rose up in the morning early, and worshiped before Yahweh, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahweh remembered her.
verses.en_bbe: And early in the morning they got up, and after worshipping before the Lord they went back to Ramah, to their house: and Elkanah had connection with his wife; and the Lord kept her in mind.

verses.en: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of the LORD.
verses.pt: De modo que Ana concebeu e, no tempo devido, teve um filho, ao qual chamou Samuel; porque, dizia ela, o tenho pedido ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: Now the time came when Hannah, being with child, gave birth to a son; and she gave him the name Samuel, Because, she said, I made a prayer to the Lord for him.

verses.en: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
verses.pt: Subiu, pois aquele homem, Elcana, com toda a sua casa, para oferecer ao Senhor o sacrifício anual e cumprir o seu voto.
verses.en_web: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
verses.en_bbe: And the man Elkanah with all his family went up to make the year's offering to the Lord, and to give effect to his oath.

verses.en: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and there abide for ever.
verses.pt: Ana, porém, não subiu, pois disse a seu marido: Quando o menino for desmamado, então e levarei, para que apareça perante o Senhor, e lá fique para sempre.
verses.en_web: But Hannah didn’t go up; for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahweh, and stay there forever.”
verses.en_bbe: But Hannah did not go, for she said to her husband, I will not go till the child has been taken from the breast, and then I will take him with me and put him before the Lord, where he may be for ever.

verses.en: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the LORD establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.
verses.pt: E Elcana, seu marido, lhe disse: faze o que bem te parecer; fica até que o desmames; tão-somente confirme o Senhor a sua palavra. Assim ficou a mulher, e amamentou seu filho, até que o desmamou.
verses.en_web: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may Yahweh establish his word.” So the woman waited and nursed her son, until she weaned him.
verses.en_bbe: And her husband Elkanah said to her, Do whatever seems right to you, but not till you have taken him from the breast; only may the Lord do as he has said. So the woman, waiting there, gave her son milk till he was old enough to be taken from the breast.

verses.en: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the LORD in Shiloh: and the child was young.
verses.pt: Depois de o ter desmamado, ela o tomou consigo, com um touro de três anos, uma efa de farinha e um odre de vinho, e o levou à casa do Senhor, em Siló; e era o menino ainda muito criança.
verses.en_web: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a bottle of wine, and brought him to Yahweh’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.
verses.en_bbe: Then when she had done so, she took him with her, with a three-year old ox and an ephah of meal and a skin full of wine, and took him to the house of the Lord at Shiloh: now the child was still very young.

verses.en: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.
verses.pt: Então degolaram o touro, e trouxeram o menino a Eli;
verses.en_web: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had made an offering of the ox, they took the child to Eli.

verses.en: And she said, Oh my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the LORD.
verses.pt: e disse ela: Ah, meu Senhor! tão certamente como vive a tua alma, meu Senhor, eu sou aquela mulher que aqui esteve contigo, orando ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And she said, O my lord, as your soul is living, my lord, I am that woman who was making a prayer to the Lord here by your side:

verses.en: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
verses.pt: Por este menino orava eu, e o Senhor atendeu a petição que eu lhe fiz.
verses.en_web: I prayed for this child; and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.
verses.en_bbe: My prayer was for this child; and the Lord has given him to me in answer to my request:

verses.en: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD. And he worshipped the LORD there.
verses.pt: Por isso eu também o entreguei ao Senhor; por todos os dias que viver, ao Senhor está entregue. E adoraram ali ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: Therefore I have also given him to Yahweh. As long as he lives he is given to Yahweh.” He worshiped Yahweh there.
verses.en_bbe: So I have given him to the Lord; for all his life he is the Lord's. Then he gave the Lord worship there.
